content: स्थानकम् [स्थान स्वार्थे क] .²1 A position, situation. .²2 A particular point or situation in dramatic action; {%<ab>e. g.</ab>%} पताकास्थानक <ab>q. v.</ab>; स्थानकेन अवलोक्य <ls>V. 4. 44/45</ls>; it may also mean ‘a kind of posture’. .²3 A city, town. .²4 A basin. .²5 Froth, a kind of scum on spirits or wine. .²6 A mode of recitation. .²7 A division or section of the Taittirīya, a branch of the {%Yajurveda%}. .²8 A temple in which the idol is kept in an erect posture. .²9 The attitude of the body (in shooting <ab>&c.</ab>).
